description: This file contains unit tests for the IdempotencyCopyAsset functionality in the DataAssetBackend project, specifically testing that repeated requests with the same idempotency key return the same response, validating idempotency behavior.

classes.name: IdempotencyCopyAssetTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies the idempotency behavior of the asset copy API endpoint to ensure repeated requests with the same idempotency key produce identical responses, using a fixture for test app setup.

methods.name: CopyAsset_with_same_idempotency_key_returns_same_response_on_retry
methods.description: A test method that sends two POST requests with the same idempotency key and verifies that responses are identical, including status codes and bodies, and that the replay header is present.
